topic.title: How did Russia get so big?
topic.map_answer: Russia's colour spreading east across the map from the Ural Mountains, fort by fort along Siberia's rivers (Ob, Yenisei, Lena), until it reaches the Pacific coast

shape.name: The relay
shape.beats: hook: the huge shape today and the question -> where it once ended, a line on the map -> who crossed it and what they were after -> the same step repeated, a colour spreading place by place across the map -> the turn: the people already living there -> payoff: how fast it reached the far coast -> loop back to the line it started from
shape.why: a why-shaped story whose answer is one small move repeated across a map, each step handing on to the next, told as a race of boats east

cta: Fur or gold: which do you think built more empires? Comment
title: Russia once ended at the Urals. Then what?
description:
How did Russia end up stretching from Europe to the Pacific?
A few hundred Cossacks, Siberia's rivers and a hunger for fur, on the map, river by river.
